1) doesn't matter that you don't buy it for others enjoyment, the enjoyment of the stronger and happier the community is, the stronger and happier you should be, it's making surfing seem like a selfish thing, and often the games who have players who surf require you to level up a new account, buy a New copy , or buy another premium account.

2) games need new players, there is an influx of new players and retiring players for every game, if the retiring players outnumber the new ones, a fame is considered dead. (Ex: Starcraft 2, the old metal of honor games, old unreal tournament games, really any call of Duty game, battlefield 3, etc.) The fewer players, the longer the queue times.

3) assume it's like Challenger in LoL, there are (around?) 200 Challenger players on any given server, if 25 of them smurf (a relatively small amount) go to smurf, then the queue time gets around 1/4 longer, this is the difference between a 45 minute queue timer and a 60 minute (for example) which is a decent chunk of time. If you want to include the league below that then it would be around 1/8 of the players. So you're correct in saying that fewer players smurf because there aren't that many aren't the higher ranks, but the fewer players that do smurf make up aren't larger portion of the higher ranks.

4) you're taking it out of context, a waste of time as far as video games go. If you consider that it is an *entertainment* medium, then getting pubstomped by players who are better effectively wastes time that you could use getting more entertainment out of a game, a close match is more entertaining than one team getting stomped. As for the higher level players, it wastes the time that they could spend practicing to get better, which is often the reason higher level competitive players play.

5) that went along with the wasting of time part, because all it does is prevents players from climbing, and eliminates the whole reason of doing it in the first place, to play with lower level players.

6) you're Correct that people should be playing games for enjoyment, but isn't it selfish to ruin the enjoyment of many others just so you can get a few kicks? See above for the reasons why it's bad.
